content: 1. General Concepts **Golden Rules of DT** 🥇 1. Nothing can be done by your opponent(s) after you have successfully activated your Ultimate Ability. 2. Rolled dice can always be altered by the other player, except during an Ultimate. 3. Any instance of damage can always be prevented or avoided with Phase-applicable cards, status effects or abilities, except during an Ultimate. 4. Damage is always accumulated and applied simultaneously at the conclusion of the Phase that you are in, unless the damage is an isolated source of undefendable dmg (and is resolved immediately in the middle of the Phase). 5. There is no “playing chicken” or going back in time after both players have agreed to progress the order of play.
